title: CmdPal: Extract dock page flyout host abstraction

review.body_prefix:

**Validation scope:** This conclusion is grounded in the retained source and actual caller assessment; it does not certify a new independent full build or interactive flyout lifecycle test.

No additional code change is requested by this assessment. This is a qualified summary, not an unconditional approval.
